extracted.name: Waldorf Salad
extracted.description: This Waldorf salad recipe is simple and delicious! I love to toss it with butter lettuce leaves for a fresh side dish or lunch.
ingredient_lines: ¼ cup whole milk Greek yogurt
2 tart apples (such as Granny Smith or Honeycrisp, chopped)
2 cups thinly sliced celery (3 to 4 ribs, plus celery leaves for garnish)
1 cup walnuts or pecans (toasted and chopped)
⅔ cup chopped fresh parsley (plus more for garnish)
instruction_lines: In a large bowl, whisk together the yogurt, mayonnaise, lemon juice, honey, salt, and several grinds of pepper.
Add the apples, celery, grapes, walnuts, and parsley and mix to combine.
Season to taste and transfer to a serving platter. Garnish with more parsley and celery leaves and serve.
